rows.text: Krark and Sakashima work as a pair: Sakashima enters as a copy of Krark, so every instant or sorcery flips two coins. One win and one loss is the result you want: the winning flip copies the spell AND the losing flip returns the original to your hand to cast again. Two losses waste the mana; two wins resolve everything but end the chain. It is a strong edge, not a guaranteed loop, so keep a deterministic kill in reserve.
A Goblin storm deck by zzwang, led by both partners. Bracket 3: the three Game Changers are Jeska's Will, Mystical Tutor and Underworld Breach. No mass land denial.

rows.name: Krark, the Thumbless
rows.text: whenever you cast an instant or sorcery, flip: lose and it returns to hand, win and it is copied. Lost spells come back to cast again, which is what grows storm.

rows.name: Sakashima of a Thousand Faces
rows.text: enters as a copy of Krark and switches off the legend rule, so both Krarks stay and every spell gets two flips.

rows.name: Krark's Thumb
rows.text: flip two and keep the better for each trigger: makes the win-plus-loss result far more likely.

rows.name: Phantasmal Image
rows.text: a third Krark while Sakashima is out; each extra Krark adds a flip.

rows.name: Phyrexian Metamorph
rows.text: another Krark copy, or a copy of Storm-Kiln Artist.

rows.name: Veyran, Voice of Duality
rows.text: Krark's triggers come from casting an instant or sorcery, so Veyran makes each one trigger twice: four flips per spell with both Krarks.

rows.name: Storm-Kiln Artist
rows.text: a Treasure for every instant or sorcery cast or copied. Krark's copies count.

rows.name: Seething Song
rows.text: the best spell to flip: one win plus one loss gives RRRRR from the copy and the Song back, net +2 mana and +1 storm per cast.

rows.name: Pyretic Ritual
rows.text: net +1 per win-plus-loss.

rows.name: Desperate Ritual
rows.text: the same, and spliceable.

rows.name: Rite of Flame
rows.text: cheap fuel; each copy counts every Rite in the graveyard.

rows.name: Jeska's Will
rows.text: copies of it are huge: red per card in an opponent's hand and three more exiled cards each.

rows.name: Strike It Rich
rows.text: a Treasure, and a flashback later.

rows.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling
rows.text: red for every spell cast, including each recast of a returned ritual.

cards.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

rows.name: Electro, Assaulting Battery
rows.text: banks red for every instant or sorcery cast.

rows.name: Tavern Scoundrel
rows.text: every won flip makes Treasures; Krark flips constantly.

rows.name: Relic of Legends
rows.text: taps Krark and Sakashima for mana, even the turn they enter.

rows.name: Cerulean Wisps
rows.text: untaps a legend for another Relic of Legends mana, and draws.

rows.name: Springleaf Drum
rows.text: taps a creature for mana, summoning sick or not.

rows.name: Vivi Ornitier
rows.text: grows with every noncreature spell and pings each opponent; its mana ability works once a turn.

rows.name: Grapeshot
rows.text: each returned and recast Grapeshot grows storm again; each won flip copies it for extra damage. Copying it does not re-trigger storm, recasting does.

rows.name: Brain Freeze
rows.text: the mill finish once storm is high.

rows.name: Lightning Bolt
rows.text: a copied Bolt is three damage per copy; with a long chain it kills a player.

rows.name: Dualcaster Mage + Twinflame
rows.text: cast Twinflame on a creature, flash Dualcaster to copy it onto Dualcaster; each hasty token copies again. Unlimited hasty attackers. Start Dualcaster's copy before Krark's flip triggers resolve.

rows.name: Dualcaster Mage + Molten Duplication
rows.text: the same loop.

rows.name: Dualcaster Mage + Heat Shimmer
rows.text: the same loop for six mana.

rows.name: Underworld Breach + Lotus Petal + Brain Freeze
rows.text: Breach first, escape Petal twice for UU, escape Freeze on yourself for 1U; each lap is three casts and mills more. Then turn Freeze on the opponents. Finish with Wheel of Fortune while each opponent's library is empty and keep seven cards in yours.

rows.name: Archmage Emeritus
rows.text: draws on every cast and copy and the draw is mandatory: bounce it with Snap before a long loop or you deck yourself.

rows.name: Imperial Recruiter -> Dualcaster Mage
rows.text: when a copy spell is in hand.

rows.name: Imperial Recruiter -> Storm-Kiln Artist
rows.text: when you want the flip chain instead.

rows.name: Mystical Tutor
rows.text: Seething Song, Grapeshot, Twinflame or Brain Freeze; it cannot find Underworld Breach.

rows.name: Muddle the Mixture
rows.text: transmute for Underworld Breach, Krark's Thumb, Brain Freeze, Grapeshot, Twinflame or Molten Duplication.

rows.name: Spellseeker
rows.text: an instant or sorcery of mana value 2 or less: Twinflame, Brain Freeze, Grapeshot or Mystical Tutor.

rows.name: Flare of Duplication
rows.text: free by sacrificing a red creature: copy the chain's best spell at the right moment.

rows.name: Past in Flames
rows.text: flashback the rituals for another lap. A flashed-back spell is exiled instead of returning to hand on a lost flip, so it gets one cast each.

rows.name: Wheel of Fortune
rows.text: a fresh seven mid-chain, and the Brain Freeze kill.

rows.name: Mogg Salvage
rows.text: free artifact removal when an opponent has an Island.

rows.name: Brainstorm
rows.text: hand selection with seven fetchlands to shuffle.

rows.name: Ponder
rows.text: one-mana selection.

rows.name: Preordain
rows.text: the same.

rows.name: Consider
rows.text: the same; copies make it draw more.

rows.name: Opt
rows.text: the same.

rows.name: Gitaxian Probe
rows.text: free storm count and a look at their hand.

rows.name: Frantic Search
rows.text: free card filtering that untaps lands.

rows.name: Harmonic Prodigy
rows.text: Krark is a Goblin Wizard, so Prodigy makes each Krark trigger twice: with Sakashima that is four flips per spell.

rows.name: Mystic Remora
rows.text: early draw before the chain turn.

rows.name: Hexing Squelcher
rows.text: your spells cannot be countered: land it before going off.

rows.name: Pact of Negation
rows.text: free on your winning turn.

rows.name: Flusterstorm
rows.text: wins counter wars mid-chain.

rows.name: Mental Misstep
rows.text: stops a one-mana answer for free.

rows.name: Mindbreak Trap
rows.text: free against another storm player.

rows.name: Swan Song
rows.text: one blue for counters and sweepers.

rows.name: Deflecting Swat
rows.text: free with a commander out.

rows.name: Pyroblast
rows.text: one red against blue answers.

rows.name: Into the Flood Maw
rows.text: bounce a Rule of Law or Damping Sphere for one blue.

rows.name: Snap
rows.text: free bounce that untaps two lands.

rows.name: Borne Upon a Wind
rows.text: flash for Dualcaster Mage's partner spells, and a card.
Keep lands of both colours, a cantrip and a mana piece. Krark comes down early as the cheap half; hold Sakashima until you can protect the pair.

Before turn 6, use the flips for value: cantrips that come back are free card selection. The compact loops (Dualcaster with a copy spell, the Breach mill) and the big storm turn wait until turn 6 by table agreement.
On the kill turn: Squelcher or a free counter first, Krark's Thumb if you have it, then rituals into Grapeshot or Brain Freeze.

rows.name: Sol Ring
rows.text: early speed into both commanders.

rows.name: Lotus Petal
rows.text: the last coloured mana, and the Breach piece.

rows.name: Simian Spirit Guide
rows.text: free red on the chain turn.
